goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Fixed the T019 defect by freezing Shift/additivity in unarmed background gesture state at pointerdown. Sub-threshold Shift pointerup now preserves selection while suppressing its successor click; unmodified sub-threshold pointerup still clears. Background drags at or above 4px remain inert with or without Shift and suppress successor clicks. Added controller, editor, and main-wiring regressions covering all four paths. Targeted verification passed 176 tests; full check passed 376 tests, typecheck, and build.
